In W–Ni–Fe alloy, the W grains get interspersed in the FCC matrix of Ni–Fe–W solid solution.
In conventionally sintered alloy, the matrix contains about 30 % dissolved W, but in microwave process, the W concentration in the matrix is about 22 %.
